leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript monorepo structure with separate packages
Configure package.json files with proper dependencies and versioning
Implement type definitions for cross-package communication
Apply TypeScript path mapping to resolve internal package imports
Initialize type checking across package boundaries
Manipulate tsconfig.json files to enforce strict type boundaries
Integrate build tools to validate package dependencies
lessonTitle: Build typed monorepo package boundary checks
